summary.text: Mike Osburn is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 81, which encompasses central Edmond, and was first elected in 2016. His House biography says he is in his third term.

paragraphs.text: Osburn graduated magna cum laude from Oklahoma Christian University in 1990 with a bachelor’s degree in history and political science, and from the University of Oklahoma College of Law in 1993.
He began his career with Gov. Frank Keating, as campaign manager in 1994 and deputy chief of staff in 1995, and then worked as political director of the Oklahoma Republican Party.
Osburn became assistant to the president at Oklahoma Christian University in 1996 and executive director of Enterprise Square USA in 1999.

He ran unsuccessfully for the Oklahoma House in 2000, served as state director for U.S. Sen. Don Nickles from 2001 to 2004, and in 2006 formed a consulting firm specializing in association and event management.
Osburn lives in Edmond with his wife and their three children.
